caption: A battery pack is clipped into a remote-control car, and the car's lights come on.

sa.check: A remote-control car and a battery pack.
The pack is clipped into the car.
The car is dark and still before the pack goes in.
The order is pack in, then lights.

pc.expect: The lights come on at the moment the pack clicks into place, and only then, and stay on.
pc.fail: The pack is in and the lights stay dark; or the lights are lit before the pack reaches the car; or the lights come on with the pack lying loose; or the lights go out again with the pack seated.

pc.expect: The car stays still: its wheels do not turn and it does not drive off, since no controller is used.
pc.fail: The wheels spin up when the pack goes in; or the car drives away by itself; or the car jerks or rocks with nothing touching it; or the steering turns.

pc.expect: The lights' glow reaches the surface in front of or behind them.
pc.fail: The lamps glow while the surface in front stays as dark as before; or the surface brightens while the lamps stay dark; or the lit patch is far from the lamps.
pc.precondition: The surface in front of the lights is in view.

pc.expect: The pack slides into its bay as a rigid block and seats with a stop; the car keeps its shape.
pc.fail: The pack squashes or bends as it goes in; or the car body deforms around it; or the pack hangs half out once clipped.

pc.expect: One car and one pack; the pack stays in once clipped; the pack enters the bay rather than the car's shell; fingers pass through nothing.
pc.fail: The pack vanishes after clipping in or a second pack appears; or the pack passes through the shell; or a wheel or light vanishes; or fingers pass through the car.

pc.expect: The car's colour and decals and the surface stay the same apart from the lights.
pc.fail: The car changes colour; or its decals change; or the surface changes.
